Standard consecutive Jacobi interlacing gives the complete stationary-root set. Exact polynomial comparison proves degrees one through three; a reproduced 126-assertion exact symbolic checker independently corroborates finite-degree formulas without serving as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a motivated sharp spectral approximation invariant on the second-variation ball (piecewise-linear curvature singularities). The single-hinge equality classification and all-degree two-Jacobi-root structure provide a natural complete exact finite computational prescription, not merely an arbitrary finite enumeration. A rigorously established parity switch and the golden-ratio degree-two displacement reveal a non-obvious geometric limitation of central-singularity heuristic. Global full-degree extremizer selection beyond finite root comparison remains open.
